# Task context

[按任务读取 Zeron 规范](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/skills/zeron-page-builder/references/task-context.md). New application: choose a standard shell; existing page: preserve the host; small control change: read only relevant contracts.

# Zeron UI for agents

Read the catalog and exact installed types before choosing a component.

- [AI usage](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/docs/ai)
- [Catalog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/catalog.json)
- [Skills installation](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/skills/install.md)

## Install

Use the verified Zeron CLI. Start with init when components.json is missing; inspect add --dry-run before installing. React 19 and Tailwind 4 are required; Next-only blocks must not be directly installed in Vite. Workspace @zeron/ui imports do not establish consumer import paths.

## Design rules

Use semantic tokens and public variants, sizes and icon slots. Preserve keyboard focus, loading and disabled states. Reuse the host shell, assign one scroll owner per region, and replace demo data with real callbacks. A clean static check is not runtime verification.

- [Sidebar](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Asidebar.md): Responsive navigation rail with desktop collapse and a mobile drawer. Registry: sidebar.
- [Sidebar Account Menu](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Asidebar-account-menu.md): Account switcher and action menu for the sidebar footer. Registry: sidebar-account-menu.
- [Sidebar Identity Row](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Asidebar-identity-row.md): Composable sidebar identity row with avatar, primary and secondary text, and trailing content. Registry: sidebar-identity-row.
- [Skeleton](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Askeleton.md): Token-native loading placeholder that composes into avatar, card, text, form, and table layouts. Registry: skeleton.
- [Slider (Base UI)](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Aslider.md): Range slider with step snapping, range mode, and animated thumb. Registry: slider.
- [SortableCollection](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Asortable-collection.md): Controlled reorderable list with optional inline editing, removal, and catalog-based adding. Registry: sortable-collection.
- [Status Overview](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Astatus-overview.md): Status bar charts for equal-duration service history and ordered node snapshots, with shared tooltips and keyboard navigation. Built with StatusOverview. Registry: status-overview.
- [Stepper (Base UI)](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Astepper.md): Accessible multi-step navigation with validation, completion states, and keyboard controls. Registry: stepper.
- [Switch (Base UI)](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Aswitch.md): Toggle switch with animated thumb and label. Registry: switch.
- [Table](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atable.md): Data table with row hover effects and semantic markup. Registry: table.
- [Tabs (Base UI)](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atabs.md): Pill, segment, and underline tabs with a sliding active indicator. Registry: tabs.
- [TabsSubtle (legacy)](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atabs-subtle.md): Compatibility adapter for Tabs' segment variant. New integrations should use Tabs with variant="segment". Registry: tabs-subtle.
- [Temporal Picker](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atemporal-picker.md): Date, time, and date-time controls with explicit commitment, relative presets, availability rules, and IANA time-zone handling. Registry: temporal-picker.
- [Textarea](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atextarea.md): Multi-line text input with semantic variants, two content sizes, resizing, and field validation support. Registry: textarea.
- [Thinking Indicator](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Athinking-indicator.md): Animated status indicator with morphing SVG and cycling text. Registry: thinking-indicator.
- [Thinking Steps](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Athinking-steps.md): Chain-of-thought display with sequential animation and collapsible steps. Registry: thinking-steps.
- [Time Range Histogram](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atime-range-histogram.md): Stacked time-bucket histogram with controlled pointer and keyboard range selection. Registry: time-range-histogram.
- [Toast](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atoast.md): Animated notification stack with statuses, automatic dismissal, actions, and drag gestures. Registry: toast.
- [Tooltip (Base UI)](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atooltip.md): Floating tooltip with spring-based animations and configurable placement. Registry: tooltip.
- [Top Nav](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atop-nav.md): Composable top navigation with brand, primary links, and actions. Registry: top-nav.
- [Tree](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/component%3Atree.md): Accessible hierarchical display and selection for general nodes, members, and files. Registry: tree.
- [Workflow Editor](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/page%3Aworkflow.md): A standalone automation canvas with editable nodes, branching, local drafts and path simulation. Not installable.
- [Icon Catalog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Acatalog.md): Searchable names generated from the free icon provider's actual exports. Not installable.
- [Chart Tokens](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Achart-tokens.md): Global chart colors, series variables, and shared styling rules for light and dark mode. Not installable.
- [Motion](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Amotion.md): Spring tokens, faster exits, and reflow-free weight animation — the motion rules shared by every component. Not installable.
- [Icons Overview](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Aoverview.md): The provider, public API, and style model behind Zeron Design icons. Not installable.
- [Icon Providers](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Aproviders.md): Free and licensed icon styles, plus the boundary for optional Pro packages. Not installable.
- [Scrollbars](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Ascrollbars.md): A scrollbar that stays out of the way but never disappears, over shadcn's scroll-fade baseline — restyled to the shape system, native scroll on touch. Not installable.
- [Semantic Tokens](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Asemantic-tokens.md): The complete runtime contract for color, surface, type, shape, and layering. Not installable.
- [Icon Usage](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/items/reference%3Ausage.md): Use named icon slots without coupling application code to a source icon library. Not installable.
